name: Usean II
description: Usean II was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Tunka sector. It was home to the rocket grass plant and the herbivore lrashtash, which had large incisor-like teeth to frighten predators. At some point, when the Imperial Wilek Nereus was stationed on Usean II, he added a set of lrashtash teeth to his dental collection. Later, when Nereus was asked about the origin of the teeth, he claimed they were from an "Useani camnzin," a predator he invented for his own entertainment and that of his inquirers.
